{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdM6m4eariBX2cLUVHUtm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WDEFHcGLEjpxTcvf9YmXyA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/qa-quiz-005/2026-07-24T151338Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/answer.md","content":"# Why production lands on mainnet.base.org\n\n## TL;DR\n\n`NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` is **inlined at build time**, not read at runtime. The\nstatic production bundle was compiled in an environment where that var was\n**not set**, so `rpcOverrides[base.id]` baked into the JS as `undefined`. With\nno override, wagmi's transport calls bare `http()`, which viem resolves to the\nchain's default public RPC — `https://mainnet.base.org` — and it gets\nrate-limited (429). Devs never see it because their `.env.local` sets the var,\nso their local build inlines the paid URL.\n\n---\n\n## The exact chain\n\n### 1. `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` is a build-time text substitution\n\nIn Next.js, any `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` reference is **not** an environment lookup in\nthe browser. During `next build`, Next.js does a literal find-and-replace:\nevery `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` in the source is swapped for the string\nliteral that was present in the build shell at compile time. The browser has no\n`process.env`; there is nothing to read at runtime.\n\nFor a **static export on generic hosting** this is terminal: there is no Node\nserver, so setting the variable in the hosting dashboard as a *runtime* env var\ndoes nothing. Only the value present when the bundle was compiled matters.\n\n### 2. Where the value diverges\n\n- **Dev machine:** `packages/nextjs/.env.local` contains\n  `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL=<paid RPC>`. `next dev` / `next build` inlines the paid\n  URL. No 429s — ever.\n- **CI / hosting build:** `.env.local` is gitignored and absent, and the var\n  wasn't exported into the **build** step (it may be set as a *runtime*\n  dashboard var, which a static export can't use). So\n  `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` inlines to `undefined`. The shipped bundle\n  literally contains `rpcOverrides: { 8453: undefined }`.\n\n### 3. `scaffold.config.ts`\n\n```ts\nrpcOverrides: { [chains.base.id]: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL } // → { 8453: undefined } in prod\n```\n\n### 4. `wagmiConfig.tsx` — the `client({ chain })` factory\n\n```ts\nlet rpcFallbacks = [http()];                         // default = public RPC\nconst rpcOverrideUrl = scaffoldConfig.rpcOverrides?.[chain.id];\nif (rpcOverrideUrl) {\n  rpcFallbacks = [http(rpcOverrideUrl), http()];     // paid first, public still present\n} else {\n  const alchemyHttpUrl = getAlchemyHttpUrl(chain.id);\n  if (alchemyHttpUrl) {\n    const isUsingDefaultKey = scaffoldConfig.alchemyApiKey === DEFAULT_ALCHEMY_API_KEY;\n    rpcFallbacks = isUsingDefaultKey ? [http(), http(alchemyHttpUrl)] : [http(alchemyHttpUrl), http()];\n  }\n}\nreturn createClient({ chain, transport: fallback(rpcFallbacks), ... });\n```\n\nIn prod, `rpcOverrideUrl` is falsy → the `else` branch. With no per-app Alchemy\nkey for Base (or the default SE-2 key), `rpcFallbacks` stays/falls to\n**`[http()]`** (and if the default Alchemy key is set, public `http()` is\n*first* anyway).\n\n### 5. What bare `http()` does\n\nviem's `http()` **with no URL** uses `chain.rpcUrls.default.http[0]`. For Base\nthat is `https://mainnet.base.org`. Every JSON-RPC call in production (polling,\nreads, `useScaffold*` hooks) fires at the public endpoint → 429.\n\n**Chain:** unset build-env var → `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` inlines `undefined` →\n`rpcOverrides[8453]=undefined` → `rpcOverrideUrl` falsy → `rpcFallbacks=[http()]`\n→ `http()` resolves to `mainnet.base.org` → rate-limited.\n\n---\n\n## The one operational check that settles it\n\n**Don't check the dashboard env var — inspect what's actually in the shipped\nbundle / on the wire.** Because the URL is build-time inlined, the only ground\ntruth is the compiled output:\n\n> Open the **production** site → DevTools → Network → filter the JSON-RPC POSTs\n> and confirm the host is the paid RPC, not `mainnet.base.org`. Equivalently:\n> `grep -r \"mainnet.base.org\"` (and the paid host) in the deployed\n> `_next/static` JS.\n\nIf the paid URL is baked in and requests go there, the fix is real. If\n`mainnet.base.org` still appears in the bundle or in the prod Network tab, it\nisn't — regardless of what the hosting dashboard shows. This also proves the\nreal fix: set `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` in the **build** environment (CI/build step)\nand **rebuild**; redeploying the same artifact or flipping a runtime var changes\nnothing.\n\n---\n\n## The second, transport-level trap (survives fixing the env var)\n\nEven once the override is correctly inlined, the override branch builds:\n\n```ts\nrpcFallbacks = [http(rpcOverrideUrl), http()];   // ← bare http() still in the list\n```\n\nand wraps it in `fallback(...)`. viem's `fallback` transport **advances to the\nnext transport on any error** from the primary — a 429, a timeout, a 5xx, a\ntransient network blip on the paid RPC. That next transport is bare `http()` =\n`mainnet.base.org`. So under exactly the conditions where the paid RPC is\nstressed, *some* production requests silently spill back onto the public\nendpoint — the very endpoint you were trying to avoid — and it's invisible\nbecause the call still succeeds.\n\n**Fix:** drop the public fallback when an override exists, e.g.\n`rpcFallbacks = [http(rpcOverrideUrl)]` (or plain `transport: http(rpcOverrideUrl)`).\nKeep a fallback only if you deliberately accept public-RPC spillover.\n\n---\n\n### Aside (related, chains-level, not the asked trap)\n\n`enabledChains` always injects Ethereum **mainnet** (chain 1) for ENS/price.\n`rpcOverrides` only covers `base.id`, so every ENS/ETH-price call goes through\nbare `http()` on chain 1 → Ethereum's default public RPC regardless of the Base\nfix. Different public endpoint, same class of leak; add a `[chains.mainnet.id]`\noverride if that traffic matters.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":628,"cache_read_input_tokens":21417,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":628},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbdb6acf-20c6-42d6-850a-32ab9dce5a90","uuid":"66be568a-8516-4fca-b057-93b412df6fd5","timestamp":"2026-07-24T15:15:21.890Z","request_id":"req_011CdM6m3PS3JNsYrsU5i8Df"}
